char.nova.name: Nova
char.nova.desc: A calm starship pilot who never misses. Fragile up close, deadly from afar.
char.nova.attack_desc: Fires a fast long-range laser bolt.
char.nova.super_desc: A huge piercing beam that crosses the whole arena.
char.rocko.name: Rocko
char.rocko.desc: A stubborn mountain bull with a stone-hard head and a bigger heart.
char.rocko.attack_desc: Five rock pellets in a wide cone. Brutal up close.
char.rocko.super_desc: Charges forward, smashing cover and knocking enemies back.
char.pip.name: Pip
char.pip.desc: A cheerful sprout who keeps the whole team blooming.
char.pip.attack_desc: A piercing seed that damages enemies and heals teammates it passes.
char.pip.super_desc: Grows a healing garden that restores allies standing inside.
char.zippa.name: Zippa
char.zippa.desc: A masked speedster who strikes before you can blink.
char.zippa.attack_desc: A quick close-range slash in a wide arc.
char.zippa.super_desc: Teleports to the target spot and slashes everyone nearby.
char.fizz.name: Fizz
char.fizz.desc: A goggled inventor whose experiments always end with a boom.
char.fizz.attack_desc: Lobs a bomb over walls that explodes on landing.
char.fizz.super_desc: Hurls a giant bomb with a huge blast that breaks cover.
char.bolt.name: Bolt
char.bolt.desc: A tidy little robot that solves problems with precise bursts.
char.bolt.attack_desc: Fires three quick shots in a row.
char.bolt.super_desc: Deploys a turret that automatically shoots nearby enemies.
char.kiwi.name: Kiwi
char.kiwi.desc: A feathered healer who throws seed pods with a smile.
char.kiwi.attack_desc: Lobs a pod that damages enemies and heals allies in the splash.
char.kiwi.super_desc: Plants a totem that heals all nearby teammates over time.
char.glacia.name: Glacia
char.glacia.desc: An ice mage who turns every battle into slow motion.
char.glacia.attack_desc: A wide piercing wave that damages and slows enemies.
char.glacia.super_desc: Summons a freezing storm that slows and hurts enemies inside.
char.anchor.name: Anchor
char.anchor.desc: An old sea captain who swings a heavy anchor like a toy.
char.anchor.super_desc: Sends a shockwave that damages and stuns every enemy it touches.
char.echo.name: Echo
char.echo.desc: A pop star whose music hurts foes and lifts friends.
char.echo.attack_desc: A piercing sound wave that damages enemies and heals allies.
char.echo.super_desc: Shields and heals herself and nearby allies, halving damage taken.
char.shade.name: Shade
char.shade.desc: A hooded thief who loves the dark and hates the spotlight.
char.shade.attack_desc: Throws a blade that flies out and returns, hitting twice.
char.shade.super_desc: Turns invisible, moves faster and recovers health.
char.cinder.name: Cinder
char.cinder.desc: A fiery bruiser who loves a warm welcome - very warm.
char.cinder.attack_desc: A short-range stream of fire that pierces enemies.
char.cinder.super_desc: Explodes in a ring of fireballs in every direction.
char.blitz.name: Blitz
char.blitz.desc: A hyperactive kid with two blasters and zero patience.
char.blitz.attack_desc: Fires two fast shots side by side.
char.blitz.super_desc: Goes into a rage: faster, stronger and reloads much quicker.
char.terra.name: Terra
char.terra.desc: A mossy stone guardian who shapes the battlefield.
char.terra.attack_desc: Lobs a rock over walls that splashes on impact.
char.terra.super_desc: Raises a temporary stone wall at the target spot.
char.rook.name: Scope
char.rook.desc: A patient sniper who waits for the perfect shot.
char.rook.attack_desc: A slow-loading but very powerful long-range shot.
char.rook.super_desc: Calls a barrage of explosions on the target area.
char.mirage.name: Mirage
char.mirage.desc: An illusionist princess who is never quite where you think.
char.mirage.attack_desc: A fast piercing star that also heals allies it passes.
char.mirage.super_desc: Creates a decoy that shoots enemies while Mirage briefly vanishes.
char.vortex.name: Vortex
char.vortex.desc: A cosmic wanderer who bends space around his fingers.
char.vortex.attack_desc: An energy orb that bounces off walls twice.
char.vortex.super_desc: Opens a black hole that pulls enemies in, then explodes.
